note: Three things a village can actually sell a party. No monsters: Bramblewick does not have any, which is the point of the place.

items.name: Bramblewick Honey Poultice
items.description: The beekeeper's own. Sticky, warm, and better than it has any right to be.

items.name: Widow Aster's Cordial
items.description: Four kinds of berry and one kind of spirit. She will not say which.
unmodelled: A second cordial in one day leaves the drinker asleep by evening

items.name: Bramblewick Wasp Jar
items.description: Sold to keep foxes off the hens. It works on people who deserve it.
